config.name: doorName
config.label: Door name
config.description: A name for this door that will be visible on the attached monitor.

config.name: channel
config.label: Channel
config.description: The channel all other computers controlling this door should communicate on.

config.name: redstoneOutputType
config.label: Redstone Output Type
config.description: The type of redstone signal the door should output.

config.name: redstoneOutputSide
config.label: Redstone Output Side
config.description: The side of the computer the redstone output should be emitted on.

config.name: delay
config.label: Delay
config.description: The time in seconds the door should remain open for.

config.name: openTime
config.label: Opening Time
config.description: The time in seconds the door takes to open.

config.name: closeTime
config.label: Closing Time
config.description: The time in seconds the door takes to close.
